# `cell2location`

Fit reference signatures and map multiple Visium libraries with optional IMC spot-count priors

- Wrapper: [`job_cell2location.sh`](https://github.com/dr-michael-haley/imcanalysis/blob/main/SLURM_scripts/job_cell2location.sh)
- Conda environment: `sbt-cell2location`
- Python module: `SpatialBiologyToolkit.scripts.cell2location_analysis`

## Inputs

- cell2location.reference_adata_path for reference/full; signatures_path for map
- cell2location.visium_inputs and optional cell_count_prior_csv or obs column

## Outputs

- cell2location.asset_folder/{reference,mapping} with models, posterior.h5ad and signatures.csv
- Execution report with training histories, library abundance maps and cell-count prior QC

## Configuration

- general, cell2location, logging

## Run

From the dataset directory containing `config.yaml`:

```bash
pl cell2location
```
